mostWorthwhile.text: Comparing the temperature and door-opening logs was the most worthwhile action: it offered a plausible explanation for most spikes while making clear that air readings do not establish every stored object's temperature.

leastWorthwhile.text: Installing the filter and fan was clear and satisfying, but the sequential fittings were less interesting as decisions because each next step was fairly obvious.

surprise.text: The completed service record revealed a renewal warning on the supply controller, shifting attention from the repaired cabinet to the need for a fallback.

arbitrary.text: Combining the forecast with the monitored cooler was less obvious than the physical repairs; I made an educated guess about how to complete the assessment.

continue.text: Yes. I would like to see how the neighborhood handles the supply warning, and the repair story made the limits of the evidence relevant to practical decisions.
